summary: Render snapshot dashboard data as inert text and bind action callbacks without interpolated JavaScript

delivery.outcome: Fix stored HTML/JavaScript injection and Unicode script copying in PLF004 snapshot lists/details; verify through Willman and publish through protected OneDev/Validator
nonGoals: Other dashboard panels, dependencies, protected CI, deployment, real IDE/agent launches and wider PLF002/004 integration are outside this bounded change.

architecture.decision: Escape all snapshot list/detail text; allowlist provider CSS classes; bind snapshot buttons and script copying through closures rather than inline interpolated data. Execute the real dashboard JavaScript in the existing Node test runtime and inspect generated HTML and callbacks.

evidence: executable regression tests preserve displayed text and exact action arguments

architecture.rollback: Protected revert of implementation; no stored-data migration.

validation.evidence: Execute dashboard JavaScript with injected tags, quotes and Unicode; inspect generated HTML, callback arguments, copy text and errors.
Normal snapshot text, provider labels and action callbacks preserve existing behavior without real launches.
Full source suite and mandatory four-window X11 pass via Willman; governed scope and hosts pass.

commands: protected exact-head OneDev and independent Validator
validation.evidence: Trusted review and protected merge bind frozen repository/PR/HEAD/ticket.
